_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry -- batch 'axis1_runners' (D9)
(docs/SIMULATOR.md SS12.3/12.4; full-coverage program).
Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULES: frontend/axis1_codespec_runner.py + frontend/joint_channel_comparison_runner.py -- the two
reproducible CPU fixture builders that construct the frontend CodeSpec / joint-channel comparison substep schedules
and drive their (GPU) record/evidence emitters + freeze guards. NEITHER module imports torch
nor quimb: they are pure orchestration over the compiler (analog_schedule / code_spec /
circuit_ir) plus a call out to the GPU evidence writers in axis1_record_evidence / joint_channel_comparison.
The AST reconcile refuses a gpu_bound out_of_scope claim on a torch-less module, so out_of_scope
is EMPTY and every public unit is registered + CPU-testable.
EIGHT public units (AST-derived; the frozen dataclasses Axis1CodeSpecRecordRunnerResult /
JointChannelComparisonRunnerResult declare no methods => they are NOT units):
codespec_runner (5): build_axis1_codespec_frontend_spec, build_axis1_codespec_4q_frontend_spec,
build_axis1_codespec_frontend_schedule (all straight-line CodeSpec/
schedule construction, branch 0/0), run_axis1_codespec_record_fixture (a
write_freeze IfExp arc), main (parse_args IfExp + validate_freeze If +
summary-freeze IfExp + passed-return IfExp).
joint_channel_comparison_runner (3):       build_joint_channel_comparison_schedule (straight-line), run_joint_channel_comparison_fixture
(write_freeze IfExp), main (same four-branch surface as codespec main).
Both modules define a top-level `main`; the two units carry distinct `unit` labels
(axis1_codespec_runner.main / joint_channel_comparison_runner.main) but qualname='main' scored against each
unit's OWN module tree (no collision -- one main per file).
GPU-CALLEE SEAM (why CPU-testable). run_*/main call write_axis1_measurement_record_evidence /
write_joint_channel_comparison_evidence, which route into _require_cuda_device (real CUDA; device='cpu' raises
'GPU-only'). The units' OWN bodies are pure orchestration; the GPU work lives in a DIFFERENT
(non-reconciled) module, so the record/evidence writer + freeze + run_* fixture are monkeypatched
at the runner-module boundary and every runner-body branch runs on CPU. The build_*_spec /
build_*_schedule compilers run REAL on CPU (no GPU).
DISCRIMINATION (the value-vs-shape lesson). Every construction is PINNED against an INDEPENDENT
recompute from the fixture inputs (not the module's own builder): the 5q/4q CodeSpec fields
(name, num_qubits, data/ancilla indices+coords, check ancilla+Pauli terms, logical index+term,
rounds, metadata), the compiled schedule's measurement_keys / detectors / observables recomputed
round-by-round, the deterministic record_layout_hash + source_hash (sha256 identity -- class-a
exact -- catches every metadata/qubit/gate mutation incl. the joint-channel comparison static-ZZ edge + H/CZ targets),
and main's summary dict recomputed field-by-field from a distinct-valued fake manifest (key-swap
mutants differ). assert_discriminates shows the round-count pin fails on a dropped/added round and
the layout pin fails on the 4q vs 5q spec.
The frozen-dataclass result containers + module __all__ are pinned (assert set(__all__)) but are
not scored units; they are exercised via the run_*/main units.
L2 MUTATION (mutmut, local, default 15x timeout): 639 mutants, 626 killed => kill_rate 0.9797
PASS. The 13 residual survivors are ALL genuine EQUIVALENT mutants, each backed by a specific
language/library normalization (no reachable behavioral difference, so unkillable):
- PauliTerm basis 'X'->'x' / 'Z'->'z' (5): PauliTerm.__post_init__ upcases via str(basis).upper()
-> identical spec/schedule/hash.
- LogicalObservableSpec(..) index=0 dropped (2): index:int=0 is the field default -> identical.
- argparse ArgumentParser(description=None) (2): the module docstring is NOT __doc__ (the
`from __future__ import annotations` line precedes it), so __doc__ is None and description is
already None either way.
- --rounds type=int -> None / type=int dropped (2): main re-wraps with int(args.rounds) and
default=2 is already int -> identical resolved rounds.
- --validate-freeze default=None dropped (2): argparse defaults an unspecified optional to None.
